pf.license.ask: The permit number, where the state's form asks for one. Any airport permit. The vehicle list: type, seats, plate and inspection date. Proof of commercial auto insurance. Any USDOT number.
pf.license.who_holds: The company holds the permit, the vehicle inspections and the insurance. Each driver holds a driver's license for the vehicle and passes the checks below.
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks_live: A required permit that the owner says the business lacks keeps that work offline. A vehicle past its inspection date is never offered. A pickup at an airport that needs a permit the company doesn't hold is never offered there.
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance_bond: Commercial auto liability at the level the state's rules set. It is shown as given by the business, not checked by Rosie.
pf.license.background_checks: Every driver: a driving-record check, and a background check where the state's rules require it, and always as the example company's own rule. Drug and alcohol testing where federal or state rules require it.
pf.license.express_company: The scheduled express line, Sam's second company, needs a permit of its own only where the state's rules ask for one for scheduled runs. Elsewhere it gives its registration only.
pf.license.not_this_work: Rides that need medical care on the way, and chartered buses for large groups, aren't offered here. They are for an ambulance service or a bus charter company.

pf.services.capacity: A private ride has one vehicle and one driver, up to 3 riders and 3 bags each (a van holds up to 8 riders). A shared seat is one of the vehicle's seats. An express van has 14 seats. No two bookings share a seat.
pf.services.nobody_home: No. The rider must be at the pickup. The pickup may be a hotel lobby, a curb or a terminal door.
pf.services.same_day: Same-day rides only when a vehicle and a driver are free, soonest first. Nothing is sent now and nobody is on call.
pf.services.not_offered: Rides that need medical care on the way; chartered coaches; luggage-only deliveries; rides for a child riding alone.

what_happens: Someone hurt or ill right now: 'Call 911 now. This is a ride service, not an ambulance.' No booking until they're safe.

A rider too unwell, impaired or abusive to ride safely: the driver may refuse the ride. The owner decides about a fee, and a refund if the ride was paid for.
A crash or a breakdown: the driver makes the rider safe, calls 911 if anyone is hurt, then the owner. The owner sends another vehicle or arranges a ride.
go_on: A child riding: booked with the right child seat, which the rider brings or books ahead (the state's rules decide the age and size).

A service animal rides free; a pet rides only in a carrier.
Items that aren't carried: fuel, fireworks and anything else the state's rules bar.
pf.safety.booking_goes_on: No, for an emergency or crisis words. Yes, for the go-on cases.

pf.visit.check_in: At pickup, the rider gives the check-in code to the driver at the door, lobby or curb. At the airport, the driver meets the rider at the door the rider named.
pf.visit.during: The driver loads the bags, checks that every rider has a seat belt, and drives the route. The driver drops the rider at the terminal door they named.
pf.visit.flight_tracking: For a ride from the airport, the driver tracks the flight. The pickup moves with a late landing, free. The first 60 minutes after landing are free to wait.
pf.visit.wait_at_pickup: The driver waits up to 10 minutes past the pickup time, then calls the rider. After 15 minutes the owner decides; a fee only if the rider agreed to it. A rider who is late for the flight because of the van is the company's side: no fee.
pf.visit.bags: At loading, the driver photographs the bags and notes any scuffs. These photos are of luggage only, never of a person.
pf.visit.done: DONE when the rider is dropped at the terminal door or the address. Then the saved card is charged, where one was saved.
pf.visit.extra_work: An extra stop or bags asked for during the ride: priced first, and the rider says yes. It is paid with the ride, never before.
pf.visit.proof: Pickup and drop-off times and miles, recorded by the driver.

pf.money.start: A private ride or a shared seat is paid in full when booking. A regular rider on a standing order saves a card and takes nothing up front. A hotel or company account takes nothing at booking.
pf.money.deposits: None by default. A group van takes a card saved; where the state's rules cap fees or deposits, the cap.
pf.money.fees: A late cancel (under 24 hours) or a no-show at the pickup: up to $30 of the $75 paid (the example company's own), only if the owner confirms it. Never when the flight was delayed or cancelled, or when the company caused the miss. Anything above the fee goes back.
pf.money.refunds: A cancel in time goes back in full. A flight the airline cancels: no fee, and the owner decides the refund.
pf.money.account: A hotel or company account takes nothing at booking. Rosie texts one bill a month for its riders' rides.
pf.money.plans: A standing order is charged ride by ride, at each drop-off. A price change is told 30 days ahead, and needs the rider's yes.
pf.money.tips: No tip line. Riders may tip the driver in cash.
pf.money.tax: A tax or airport fee line only where the state or the airport requires it, shown before the yes.
pf.money.rosfield_fee: The usual $2 per confirmed booking, paid by the company. A round trip is two bookings.

pf.staff.supervision: A new driver rides along with a trained driver first.

pf.rules.permit: Where the state's or the airport's rules require it: the permit number shown, vehicle inspections and driver checks.
pf.rules.records: Trip records (pickup and drop-off times, miles, the code or a signature): 7 years, or longer where the state's rules ask.
pf.rules.child_seats: Child seats follow the state's rules for age, height and weight. The driver doesn't start the ride if a child has no fitting seat.
pf.rules.seat_belts: Every rider has a seat belt. The driver doesn't start the ride with more riders than seat belts.
pf.rules.drivers: Federal hours-of-service and drug and alcohol testing rules for drivers who need a commercial license.
pf.rules.accessibility: Federal accessibility rules for wheelchair lifts and securement, where they apply.

matter_most: The flight is delayed: the pickup moves with it, with no fee and no extra wait charge.
The flight is cancelled: the ride is cancelled with no fee, and the owner decides the refund.
The rider isn't at the pickup: the driver waits 10 minutes, then calls; after 15 minutes the owner decides.
More riders or bags than booked: the extra is priced first; with more riders than seat belts, the ride doesn't start as booked.
A child with no fitting seat: the ride doesn't start until a seat is fitted or another van brings one.
A driver is out: another driver with the right vehicle takes it; the rider is told the new name.
A breakdown or a crash: the driver makes the rider safe, then the owner sends another vehicle.
Ice, snow or a closed road: a ride may move; a rider with a flight to catch is told as early as possible.
A bag is lost or scuffed: the loading photos are the record, and the owner decides.
pf.edges.rest: All other edge cases are handled the generic way.
